name: begin_question
description: Call this immediately before asking the expert any question, every time, then speak the question. Links the question to the pointing event it is about.

event_id.description: The event_id of the pointing event the question is about (for example evt-001). Use "none" when the question is not about any pointing event.

kind.description: The kind of question: explain, reasoning, distinction, context, guardrail, exception, clarify_reference (which region do you mean), gap (debrief: an agenda gap) or correction (teach-back: what should change).

question.description: The exact question you are about to ask, as you will say it.

phase.description: The phase you are in: live (during the task, default), debrief (after [PHASE debrief]) or teach_back (after [TEACH_BACK ...]).

gap_id.description: Debrief only: the gap_id from the [PHASE debrief] agenda this question is about. Use "none" outside the debrief.

name: record_coverage
description: Call silently right after the expert has answered one of your questions, before you say anything else. Records which aspects their answer covered. Never call it before they answered.

exchange_id.description: The exchange_id returned by begin_question for the question the expert just answered (for example ex-003).

dimensions.description: The aspects the answer addressed. Leave out anything the answer did not address.

dimension.description: decision: what they decide or do; reason: why; cues: what they look at or need to know; alternatives: what looks similar and how to tell apart; guardrails: when to stop, escalate or distrust; unresolved: cases they are unsure about.

status.description: covered: fully answered; partial: touched on; unknown_escalate: the expert said they do not know or would escalate it.

note.description: A few words of your own summary. Never presented as the expert's words.

name: signal_task_complete
description: Call once, silently, when the expert says they have finished the task (for example "I'm done", "that's it"). It ends the live part and returns the debrief agenda.

reason.description: The expert's words that signalled the end, briefly.

name: propose_draft
description: Debrief: call when no open agenda gap is left (or after a correction in the teach-back). Proposes the workflow as ordered steps. The system checks the evidence, numbers the revision and returns the [TEACH_BACK] block to deliver.

steps.description: The workflow in order, written as instructions a newcomer could apply.

text.description: The step in process terms ("First check ..., if ... then ..., stop and escalate when ..."). Keep the expert's qualifiers. Anything in double quotes must be copied word for word from the expert's answers.

event_ids.description: The pointing events (screen moments) this step is about.

exchange_ids.description: The exchanges whose answers support this step.

change_reason.description: After a correction: what the expert corrected, in their terms. Otherwise "none".

name: confirm_revision
description: Teach-back: call only after the expert has explicitly answered your teach-back. confirmed only if they clearly agree; corrected if they change anything; unresolved if they cannot say. Never call it on silence or when they change the subject.

revision_id.description: The revision you taught back, from the [TEACH_BACK rev-n] block (for example rev-2).

step_ids_reviewed.description: The step ids you taught back (from the [TEACH_BACK] block).
